title: Aiming deliberately in a busy shop
target: How to use the aim hints and aim settings in Supermarket Simulator so you act on the right thing when the shop is full.
version: 1.6.0 (223), read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)
prerequisites: A shop with customers in it
Something you intend to pick up or use
A moment to look before you press

steps.do: Wait for the hint before acting, rather than assuming what a thing does.
steps.because: the game shows aim hints through their own controller and display (AimHintDisplay)

steps.do: Aim at the object itself rather than near it.
steps.because: aim is tracked by slot rather than as one universal marker (AimSlot)

steps.do: Change how the aim looks if you keep losing it against the shop.
steps.because: the aim has a colour preview you can set (AimColorPreview)

steps.do: Look at the aim settings once rather than fighting them every day.
steps.because: there is a settings menu and a set of aim settings of its own (AimSettingsMenu)

steps.do: Do not confuse the crosshair with the aim itself.

commonMistakes: Aiming near an object instead of at it.
Never looking at the aim settings.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
